draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.10, the 97th-best grade among 241 2018 draftees and 7th of 12 at QB. He lasted until pick 199, well after his grade rank (97th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Mike Glennon. Testing concerns: vertical jump (4th percentile), broad jump (4th percentile). College production: 3,593 passing yards in 2017, 9th of 13 QBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: inactive. Last NFL action came in 2019. 3 career games and 2 starts over 1 completed season. Career-best season: 1 AV in 2019. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (3rd percentile).
